translation.hero_title:
Your Digital Gateway to
Essential Government Services
translation.hero_desc: Connect directly with your Grama Niladhari division, request official certifications, schedule fast appointments, and view critical announcements online.
translation.about_title:
Bringing Government Services
Closer to Every Citizen
translation.about_desc_1: Smart Grama Sewa is a digital platform developed to bridge the gap between citizens and their local Grama Niladhari (GN) officers — making everyday government services accessible from anywhere, at any time.
translation.about_desc_2: Whether you need to request a certificate, check the status of your application, or simply reach your assigned GN officer, Smart Grama Sewa puts the Grama Niladhari office at your fingertips — no queuing, no paperwork delays.
translation.about_desc_3: Built in partnership with local government authorities, our platform is designed to serve all communities across Sri Lanka in Sinhala, Tamil, and English.
translation.feat_cert_desc: Apply for character, residence, and income certificates online.
translation.feat_book_desc: Schedule meetings with your GN officer without visiting the office.
translation.feat_news_desc: Receive announcements and notices from your local division directly.
translation.feat_comm_desc: Message your assigned GN officer securely through the portal.
translation.news_info: All notices below are publicly accessible — no account required.
translation.news_empty: No public announcements at this time.
translation.news_empty_sub: Check back soon for updates from your local division.
translation.news_cta_title: Want notices from your GN division?
translation.news_cta_desc: Log in to receive personalised updates and track your requests.
translation.contact_follow_sub: Sri Lanka e-Government portal & divisional social pages.
translation.contact_faq_desc: Find quick answers to common queries
translation.contact_gn_desc: To contact your assigned Grama Niladhari officer, please login to your citizen account. Your GN officer is linked based on your registered GN division.
